name: player_select_modal_state_by_master_type
description: zUtil_SaveGameState::SelectModalStateByMasterType selects the modal state whose master modal data matches the requested master type.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this Player modal-state helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x438540 validates the thiscall save-state ABI, list head at saveState+0x14, PlayerModalState::masterModalData at +0x4, PlayerMasterModalData::masterType at +0xa4, loop traversal through PlayerModalState::next at +0x0, StopModalLoopSfxHandle calls in order 2, 0, 1, primaryModalState write at saveState+0x8, and return values 1 for a match or 0 for empty/no-match lists.
The native smoke verifies empty-list and no-match failure, primary modal preservation on failure, primary replacement on match, and clearing of the previous primary modal loop SFX slots 0, 1, and 2.
